name: Condition Blue
original_name: コンディション・ブルー
source:
Main character visits pension "Grüné" to consider including it into a new tourist tour under premise "Let's return to nature!". He pretends to be an ordinary customer and inquires the local girls about the stories of the place. As he advances his investigation, he faces unexpected issues...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角拜访“Grüné”养老院，考虑将其纳入新的旅游线路，前提是“回归自然吧！”。他假装成一名普通顾客，向当地女孩询问这里的故事。随着调查的深入，他遇到了意想不到的问题……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
